p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u075/system/state/workspace/programs/task-73e9613c.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seeds = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    # Extend each signal along both diagonals, starting at its marker.
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        for dr,dc in ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)):
            y,x=r,c
            while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w:
                if out[y][x] == 0: out[y][x]=v
                y+=dr; x+=dc
    return out
'''
